coverage: ctypes executes real kernel32 CreateFileW/GetFileInformationByHandle/GetFinalPathNameByHandleW against owned NTFS-style filesystem fixtures. It transcribes the pinned C++ DiskPath control flow and uses frozen lexical contract. No FString/Unreal stubs, no pretend UE tests. Does NOT establish C++ compilation or full SettingsOwned runtime behavior.

Real FSCTL_SET_REPARSE_POINT junctions and CreateHardLinkW links target only other paths inside the same fresh owned fixture. Root replacement uses actual MoveFileW and real volume/file identity comparisons.
All 33 assertions passed, but four are successful demonstrations of incomplete security without exclusive ownership; they must not be counted as four isolation guarantees.

Actual shell32 CommandLineToArgvW confirms quoted UserDir with spaces and detects token differences. New strict exact-line/list validator refuses duplicate/conflicting/ambiguous tokens. It is not installed in frozen01 and is not UE FParse execution. Enclosing real launcher still needs whole-command validation and effective UE path readbacks.
findings: Junction ancestor/root/file candidates refused; both hardlink names refused; missing final regular file allowed but missing directories/parents refused; changed root ID rejected on fresh check.

After root check returns, a root may be replaced and a later descendant path check may succeed against the replacement. Controlled replacement after ancestor handle closure inside walker likewise succeeds. Closed snapshots do not lock names.
A previously absent leaf can acquire a hardlink before a later write. A fresh check rejects that link; a cached true result provides no protection.
Metadata-only READ_ATTRIBUTES handle omitted FILE_SHARE_DELETE yet did not block rename on this machine. Do not implement a lease on that assumption.

Retained GENERIC_READ directory handle without FILE_SHARE_DELETE blocked root rename with ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION=32. Rename succeeded after handle close. This proves one OS mechanism only: it does not stop descendant mutation, hardlink creation, or same-account hostile writers.
data.required_integration: Keep settings01 frozen. Any later lease implementation must bind actual process/root identity and maintain exclusive ACL/identity ownership through writes and shutdown. A generic-read root handle may supplement but cannot replace these premises. If a real launcher cannot enforce them, SettingsOwned must stay false. No rewrite/adoption approved by these tests.

Each invocation was supervised with a 45-second subprocess timeout; in-run checks enforce 30-second cooperative budget. No claim Win32 filesystem calls themselves are preemptible.

Unsupported operations fail, never skip into pass. Use an external 45-second timeout as in recorded run; no automatic repeats.
